title: 29 By ANT
description: This dataset comprises neuroimaging recordings from participants undergoing laser pain stimulation with concurrent pain intensity ratings. Participants received 160 laser stimulations of varying intensities across 4 blocks, with pain ratings collected on a 0-10 scale. The study investigates pain perception and modulation mechanisms through controlled nociceptive stimulation paradigms.
methods_description: Participants underwent laser stimulation at fixed intervals (~20 seconds) with individualized intensity calibration performed for each participant to determine energy levels corresponding to pain ratings of 4 and 7. Each block contained 40 trials (20 high intensity, 20 low intensity) across 4 blocks (160 total stimulations). Following each laser stimulus, there was a 3-second pause. Participants then rated pain intensity (0-10 scale) within a 5-second window using a computer mouse and keyboard. Intertrial intervals were randomized between 1-3 seconds after rating completion. Participants were instructed to focus attention on laser stimuli, keep eyes open, and fixate gaze on a cross displayed on screen.
